ERROR_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?:\berror\b|\bfailed\b|\bfailure\b|\bexception\b|traceback|"
    r"permission denied|unauthorized|invalid request|timed?\s*out|connection refused|"
    r"not found)", re.I,
)
FAILURE_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?:\bi(?:'m| am)? sorry\b.{0,80}\b(?:cannot|can't|unable|failed)\b|"
    r"\b(?:cannot|can't|unable to|could not|couldn't|failed to)\b|"
    r"\b(?:task|request|operation) (?:failed|was not completed)\b)", re.I | re.S,
)
CODE_RE = re.compile(r"\b(code|repo|repository|python|typescript|bug|test|deploy|file|patch)\b", re.I)
MESSAGE_RE = re.compile(r"\b(slack|teams|message|channel|coworker|reply|notify)\b", re.I)
READ_RE = re.compile(r"\b(read|search|find|summari[sz]e|report|audit|inspect|review)\b", re.I)
SIDE_EFFECT_RE = re.compile(r"\b(send|delete|upload|deploy|publish|write|edit|patch|remove)\b", re.I)
HIGH_STAKES_RE = re.compile(r"\b(legal|medical|security|permission|credential|invoice|payment)\b", re.I)
TRIGGER_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*-\s*Triggered by:\s*`([^`]+)`", re.M)


def _text(item: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    content = item.get("content")
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content
    if isinstance(content, list):
        return " ".join(
            str(part.get("text", "")) for part in content
            if isinstance(part, dict)
            and part.get("type") in ("input_text", "output_text", "text")
        )
    return ""


def _tool_name(item: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[str]:
    return item.get("name") or (item.get("function") or {}).get("name")


def _tool_output_text(item: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    value = item.get("output", item.get("content", ""))
    return value if isinstance(value, str) else json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)


def _family(model: str) -> str:
    return "claude" if model.startswith("claude") else "gpt"


def infer_family(tools: Sequence[Dict[str, Any]], default_model: str = "") -> str:
    """Infer the compatible model family from the pre-call tool dialect."""
    names = {_tool_name(tool) for tool in tools if isinstance(tool, dict)}
    if names & {"bash", "file_edit", "file_write", "file_read"}:
        return "claude"
    if names & {"shell_command", "apply_patch"}:
        return "gpt"
    return _family(default_model) if default_model else "unknown"

V1_FEATURE_NAMES = (
    "bias", "log_initial_tokens", "tool_count", "has_image", "trigger_cron",
    "trigger_user", "intent_code", "intent_message", "intent_read",
    "intent_side_effect", "intent_high_stakes",
)

# All additions are available at call zero: no realized tool choice, future error,
# eventual depth, or final output enters the policy.
ENRICHED_FEATURE_NAMES = V1_FEATURE_NAMES + (
    "trigger_automation", "trigger_unknown",
    "size_xs", "size_s", "size_m", "size_l",
    "surface_slack", "surface_teams", "tool_memory", "tool_subagent",
    "tool_external_write",
)


def _has_image(items: Sequence[Dict[str, Any]]) -> bool:
    for item in items:
        content = item.get("content") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
        if isinstance(content, list) and any(
            isinstance(part, dict) and part.get("type") in ("input_image", "image_url")
            for part in content
        ):
            return True
    return False


def _base_features(opening: str, first_input: Sequence[Dict[str, Any]], tools: Sequence[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Tuple[List[float], Dict[str, float]]:
    trigger_match = TRIGGER_RE.search(opening)
    trigger = trigger_match.group(1).lower() if trigger_match else ""
    initial_tokens = est_tokens(list(first_input)) + est_tokens(list(tools))
    tool_names = {_tool_name(tool) for tool in tools if isinstance(tool, dict)}
    values = {
        "bias": 1.0,
        "log_initial_tokens": min(math.log1p(initial_tokens) / 12.0, 1.0),
        "tool_count": min(len(tools) / 20.0, 1.0),
        "has_image": float(_has_image(first_input)),
        "trigger_cron": float(trigger == "cron"),
        "trigger_user": float(bool(trigger) and trigger not in ("cron", "trigger")),
        "intent_code": float(bool(CODE_RE.search(opening))),
        "intent_message": float(bool(MESSAGE_RE.search(opening))),
        "intent_read": float(bool(READ_RE.search(opening))),
        "intent_side_effect": float(bool(SIDE_EFFECT_RE.search(opening))),
        "intent_high_stakes": float(bool(HIGH_STAKES_RE.search(opening))),
        "trigger_automation": float(trigger == "trigger"),
        "trigger_unknown": float(not trigger),
        "size_xs": float(initial_tokens < 10_000),
        "size_s": float(10_000 <= initial_tokens < 25_000),
        "size_m": float(25_000 <= initial_tokens < 50_000),
        "size_l": float(initial_tokens >= 50_000),
        "surface_slack": float(any("slack" in (name or "") for name in tool_names)),
        "surface_teams": float(any("msteams" in (name or "") for name in tool_names)),
        "tool_memory": float("memory_search" in tool_names),
        "tool_subagent": float("submit_subagent_result" in tool_names),
        "tool_external_write": float(any(
            token in (name or "") for name in tool_names
            for token in ("send_", "upload", "delete", "react")
        )),
    }
    return [values[name] for name in V1_FEATURE_NAMES], values


def _split(group_key: str) -> str:
    value = int(hashlib.sha256((SEED + ":" + group_key).encode()).hexdigest()[:8], 16)
    return "train" if value % 100 < 70 else "validation"


def outcome_from_items(items: Sequence[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Outcome:
    assistants = [
        item for item in items if isinstance(item, dict)
        and item.get("role") == "assistant"
    ]
    final_text = _text(assistants[-1]) if assistants else ""
    terminal_language = bool(FAILURE_RE.search(final_text))

    outputs = [
        (index, item) for index, item in enumerate(items)
        if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("type") in (
            "function_call_output", "custom_tool_call_output",
            "function_call_output", "custom_tool_call_output",
        )
    ]
    unresolved_tool_error = bool(outputs and ERROR_RE.search(_tool_output_text(outputs[-1][1])))

    signatures: List[str] = []
    for item in items:
        if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("type") not in (
            "function_call", "custom_tool_call",
        ):
            continue
        args = item.get("arguments", item.get("input", ""))
        if not isinstance(args, str):
            args = json.dumps(args, sort_keys=True)
        signatures.append("%s:%s" % (_tool_name(item), re.sub(r"\s+", " ", args).strip()))
    run = maximum = 0
    previous = None
    for signature in signatures:
        run = run + 1 if signature == previous else 1
        maximum = max(maximum, run)
        previous = signature
    return Outcome(terminal_language, unresolved_tool_error, maximum >= 3)


def trajectory_from_row(row: Dict[str, Any], row_index: int) -> Trajectory:
    items = row.get("input") or []
    tools = row.get("tools") or []
    spans = decompose(items)
    if not spans:
        raise ValueError("row %d has no model-authored call" % row_index)
    calls: List[Call] = []
    tools_tokens = est_tokens(tools)
    for index, (start, stop) in enumerate(spans):
        next_start = spans[index + 1][0] if index + 1 < len(spans) else len(items)
        input_items = items[:start]
        previous_start = spans[index - 1][0] if index else None
        # Match cost_model.shared_prefix_tokens and the explorer exactly: cacheable
        # history is the sum of equal item estimates, not a newly serialized list
        # (whose commas/brackets would add a small, artificial discrepancy).
        cacheable = sum(est_tokens(item) for item in items[:previous_start]) + tools_tokens if previous_start is not None else 0

            index=index,

def _sigmoid(value: float) -> float:
    if value >= 0:
        z = math.exp(-min(value, 40.0))
        return 1.0 / (1.0 + z)
    z = math.exp(max(value, -40.0))
    return z / (1.0 + z)


class BinaryLogit:
    """Small deterministic L2 logistic regression for the offline laptop path."""

    def __init__(self, l2: float = 2.0, iterations: int = 1_200):
        self.l2, self.iterations, self.weights = l2, iterations, []

    def fit(self, xs: Sequence[Sequence[float]], ys: Sequence[int]) -> "BinaryLogit":
        if not xs:
            raise ValueError("cannot fit empty outcome model")
        self.weights = [0.0] * len(xs[0])
        n = len(xs)
        for step in range(self.iterations):
            gradient = [0.0] * len(self.weights)
            for x, y in zip(xs, ys):
                error = _sigmoid(sum(w * v for w, v in zip(self.weights, x))) - y
                for j, value in enumerate(x):
                    gradient[j] += error * value
            rate = 0.35 / math.sqrt(1.0 + step / 80.0)
            for j in range(len(self.weights)):
                penalty = 0.0 if j == 0 else self.l2 * self.weights[j]
                self.weights[j] -= rate * (gradient[j] + penalty) / n
        return self

    def predict(self, x: Sequence[float]) -> float:
        return min(max(_sigmoid(sum(w * v for w, v in zip(self.weights, x))), 0.001), 0.999)


class Softmax:
    """Deterministic multinomial propensity model."""

    def __init__(self, labels: Sequence[str], l2: float = 2.0, iterations: int = 1_000):
        self.labels = list(labels)
        self.l2, self.iterations, self.weights = l2, iterations, []

    def fit(self, xs: Sequence[Sequence[float]], ys: Sequence[str]) -> "Softmax":
        self.weights = [[0.0] * len(xs[0]) for _ in self.labels]
        n = len(xs)
        for step in range(self.iterations):
            gradients = [[0.0] * len(xs[0]) for _ in self.labels]
            for x, y in zip(xs, ys):
                probabilities = self.predict(x)
                for k, label in enumerate(self.labels):
                    error = probabilities[label] - float(y == label)
                    for j, value in enumerate(x):
                        gradients[k][j] += error * value
            rate = 0.3 / math.sqrt(1.0 + step / 80.0)
            for k in range(len(self.labels)):
                for j in range(len(xs[0])):
                    penalty = 0.0 if j == 0 else self.l2 * self.weights[k][j]
                    self.weights[k][j] -= rate * (gradients[k][j] + penalty) / n
        return self

    def predict(self, x: Sequence[float]) -> Dict[str, float]:
        scores = [sum(w * v for w, v in zip(row, x)) for row in self.weights]
        top = max(scores)
        exp = [math.exp(value - top) for value in scores]
        total = sum(exp)
        return {label: value / total for label, value in zip(self.labels, exp)}


@dataclass
class FamilyModel:
    candidates: List[str]
    outcome_model: BinaryLogit
    propensity_model: Softmax
    counts: Dict[str, int]
    context_p90: int
    feature_names: Tuple[str, ...] = V1_FEATURE_NAMES
    propensity_alpha: float = 0.0
    priors: Dict[str, float] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def vector(self, trajectory: Trajectory) -> List[float]:
        return [trajectory.feature_values[name] for name in self.feature_names]

    def augmented(self, base: Sequence[float], model: str) -> List[float]:
        values = list(base)
        for candidate in self.candidates[1:]:
            active = float(model == candidate)
            values.append(active)
            values.extend(active * value for value in base[1:])
        return values

    def risk(self, trajectory: Trajectory, model: str) -> float:
        return self.outcome_model.predict(self.augmented(self.vector(trajectory), model))

    def propensity(self, trajectory: Trajectory) -> Dict[str, float]:
        raw = self.propensity_model.predict(self.vector(trajectory))
        if not self.propensity_alpha:
            return raw
        # Dirichlet-style shrinkage toward the family model mix.  The local
        # pseudo-count is fixed before evaluation; alpha is an ablation parameter.
        local_strength = 20.0
        pooled = {
            candidate: (
                local_strength * raw[candidate]
                + self.propensity_alpha * self.priors[candidate]
            ) / (local_strength + self.propensity_alpha)
            for candidate in self.candidates
        }
        total = sum(pooled.values())
        return {candidate: value / total for candidate, value in pooled.items()}

def _effective_n(weights: Sequence[float]) -> float:
    return (sum(weights) ** 2 / sum(value * value for value in weights)) if weights else 0.0


def estimate_policy(trajectories: Sequence[Trajectory], fitted: Dict[str, FamilyModel], actions: Dict[str, str], official: bool, seed_suffix: str = "") -> Dict[str, float]:
    """Estimate downgrade-from-default risk in common support.

    The target policy accepts ``default_model`` as an input and either keeps it or
    downgrades it.  That is an ATT-style estimand, not a treatment policy independent
    of the logged action, so a vanilla AIPW equation is inappropriate.  We use the
    held-out outcome regression for the risk contrast, propensity-screen the proposed
    alternate, and cluster-bootstrap trajectories.  Unchanged decisions contribute
    exactly zero by construction.
    """
    contributions: List[float] = []
    weights: List[float] = []
    covered = 0
    for trajectory in trajectories:
        model = fitted[trajectory.family]
        if trajectory.logged_model not in model.candidates:
            continue
        action = actions.get(trajectory.trajectory_id, trajectory.logged_model)
        if action not in model.candidates:
            action = trajectory.logged_model
        propensities = model.propensity(trajectory)
        action_propensity = propensities.get(action, 0.0)
        if action_propensity < MIN_PROPENSITY:
            action = trajectory.logged_model
        else:
            covered += int(action != trajectory.logged_model)
        mu_policy = model.risk(trajectory, action)
        mu_logged = model.risk(trajectory, trajectory.logged_model)
        if action == trajectory.logged_model:
            contributions.append(0.0)
        else:
            contributions.append(mu_policy - mu_logged)
            weights.append(1.0 / max(propensities[action], MIN_PROPENSITY))
    estimate = statistics.fmean(contributions) if contributions else 0.0
    rng = random.Random(SEED + seed_suffix)
    boots = []
    for _ in range(BOOTSTRAPS):
        sample = [contributions[rng.randrange(len(contributions))] for _ in contributions]
        boots.append(statistics.fmean(sample))
    boots.sort()
    upper = boots[min(int(0.95 * len(boots)), len(boots) - 1)] if boots else estimate
    return {
        "failure_delta": estimate,
        "failure_upper95": upper,
        "evaluation_n": len(contributions),
        "routed_coverage": covered / len(contributions) if contributions else 0.0,
        "effective_n": _effective_n(weights) if weights else len(contributions),
    }


def _proposal_priority(trajectory: Trajectory, route_data: Dict[str, Any], pricing: Dict[str, Sequence[float]]) -> Tuple[float, float]:
    initial = route_data["certified"][0]
    risks = route_data["risks"]
    risk_delta = risks[initial] - risks.get(trajectory.logged_model, risks[initial])
    logged, _ = route_cost(trajectory, [trajectory.logged_model] * len(trajectory.calls), pricing)
    routed, _ = route_cost(trajectory, route_data["certified"], pricing)
    return risk_delta, -(logged - routed)


def _adopt_actions(trajectories: Sequence[Trajectory], proposals: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]], pricing: Dict[str, Sequence[float]], fraction: float) -> Dict[str, str]:
    changed = [t for t in trajectories if proposals[t.trajectory_id]["certified"][0] != t.logged_model]
    changed.sort(key=lambda t: _proposal_priority(t, proposals[t.trajectory_id], pricing))
    take = int(round(fraction * len(changed)))
    adopted = {t.trajectory_id for t in changed[:take]}
    return {
        t.trajectory_id: proposals[t.trajectory_id]["certified"][0] if t.trajectory_id in adopted else t.logged_model
        for t in trajectories
    }


def _frontier(trajectories: Sequence[Trajectory], fitted: Dict[str, FamilyModel], official_fitted: Dict[str, FamilyModel], proposals: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]], pricing: Dict[str, Sequence[float]], output_ratios: Dict[str, float], selected_fraction: Optional[float] = None) -> Tuple[List[Dict[str, Any]], float]:
    rows = []
    for step in range(11):
        fraction = step / 10.0
        actions = _adopt_actions(trajectories, proposals, pricing, fraction)
        quality = estimate_policy(trajectories, fitted, actions, official=False, seed_suffix="-%s" % fraction)
        official = estimate_policy(trajectories, official_fitted, actions, official=True, seed_suffix="-official-%s" % fraction)
        logged_cost = routed_cost = adjusted_cost = 0.0
        for trajectory in trajectories:
            logged_route = [trajectory.logged_model] * len(trajectory.calls)
            route = [actions[trajectory.trajectory_id]] * len(trajectory.calls)
            logged_cost += route_cost(trajectory, logged_route, pricing)[0]
            routed_cost += route_cost(trajectory, route, pricing)[0]
            adjusted_cost += route_cost(trajectory, route, pricing, output_ratios=output_ratios)[0]
        rows.append({
            "adopt_frac": fraction,
            "cost_usd_est": round(routed_cost, 4),
            "behavior_adjusted_cost_usd_est": round(adjusted_cost, 4),
            "savings_pct": round((1.0 - routed_cost / logged_cost) * 100.0, 2) if logged_cost else 0.0,
            "proxy_quality": round(1.0 - quality["failure_delta"], 4),
            "failure_delta": round(quality["failure_delta"], 5),
            "failure_upper95": round(quality["failure_upper95"], 5),
            "official_failure_delta": round(official["failure_delta"], 5),
            "official_failure_upper95": round(official["failure_upper95"], 5),
            "coverage": round(quality["routed_coverage"], 4),
            "effective_n": round(quality["effective_n"], 1),
            "selected": False,
        })
    if selected_fraction is None:
        eligible = [row for row in rows if row["failure_upper95"] <= QUALITY_MARGIN]
        selected = min(eligible, key=lambda row: row["cost_usd_est"]) if eligible else rows[0]
        selected_fraction = selected["adopt_frac"]
    selected = min(rows, key=lambda row: abs(row["adopt_frac"] - selected_fraction))
    selected["selected"] = True
    return rows, selected["adopt_frac"]


def corrected_baseline(trajectory: Trajectory) -> List[str]:
    total = sum(call.input_tokens + call.tools_tokens for call in trajectory.calls)
    if total >= 15_000:
        return [trajectory.logged_model] * len(trajectory.calls)
    cheap = "claude-sonnet-5" if trajectory.family == "claude" else "gpt-5.6-luna"
    return [cheap] * len(trajectory.calls)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Routemaxxing: an interpretable, family-preserving model router and honest OPE.

The real export behaves like one complete agent history per JSONL row.  We unfold each
history into the model calls it contains, retain the official "final output missing"
interpretation for the primary estimate, and keep the observed terminal assistant text
as an explicitly labelled sensitivity signal.

The certified policy chooses one model for a whole trajectory.  The adaptive policy may
escalate once after an observed error/retry/context-growth signal, never downgrade, and
is reported as conditional on logged states rather than as an identified causal effect.

No API key, GPU, sklearn, or measured token usage is required.  All token counts are
estimated as serialized JSON characters / 4.

Usage:
    python scripts/routemaxxing.py export/

Writes results/routemaxxing/ plus results/routemaxxing.jsonl for the explorer join.

    unresolved_tool_error = bool(outputs and ERROR_RE.search(_tool_output_text(outputs[-1][1])))

    signatures: List[str] = []
    for item in items:
        if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("type") not in (
            "function_call", "custom_tool_call",

        args = item.get("arguments", item.get("input", ""))

        signatures.append("%s:%s" % (_tool_name(item), re.sub(r"\s+", " ", args).strip()))
    run = maximum = 0
    previous = None
    for signature in signatures:
        run = run + 1 if signature == previous else 1

def trajectory_from_row(row: Dict[str, Any], row_index: int) -> Trajectory:
    items = row.get("input") or []
    tools = row.get("tools") or []
    spans = decompose(items)
    if not spans:
        raise ValueError("row %d has no model-authored call" % row_index)
    calls: List[Call] = []
    tools_tokens = est_tokens(tools)
    for index, (start, stop) in enumerate(spans):
        next_start = spans[index + 1][0] if index + 1 < len(spans) else len(items)
        input_items = items[:start]
        previous_start = spans[index - 1][0] if index else None
        # Match cost_model.shared_prefix_tokens and the explorer exactly: cacheable
        # history is the sum of equal item estimates, not a newly serialized list
        # (whose commas/brackets would add a small, artificial discrepancy).
        cacheable = sum(est_tokens(item) for item in items[:previous_start]) + tools_tokens if previous_start is not None else 0
        calls.append(Call(
            index=index,
            input_items=input_items,
            observed_output=items[start:stop],
            environment_delta=items[stop:next_start],
            input_tokens=est_tokens(input_items),
            tools_tokens=tools_tokens,
            output_tokens=est_tokens(items[start:stop]),
            cacheable_tokens=cacheable,
            is_final=index == len(spans) - 1,
        ))
    trajectory_id = sha(items, 12)
    opening = first_user_text(row)
    meta = extract(row)
    clean_thread = None if path_is_collapsed(meta["thread_path"]) else meta["thread_path"]
    grouping = "%s:%s" % (meta["tenant"], clean_thread) if clean_thread else trajectory_id
    features, values = _base_features(opening, calls[0].input_items, tools)
    logged = row["model"]
    inferred = infer_family(tools, logged)
    family = _family(logged)
    if inferred not in (family, "unknown"):
        raise ValueError("tool dialect/model family mismatch in row %d" % row_index)
    return Trajectory(
        row=row_index, trajectory_id=trajectory_id, logged_model=logged, family=family,
        items=items, tools=tools, calls=calls, opening=opening, group_key=grouping,
        split=_split(grouping), features=features, feature_values=values,
        outcome=outcome_from_items(items),
    )

def _sigmoid(value: float) -> float:
    if value >= 0:
        z = math.exp(-min(value, 40.0))
        return 1.0 / (1.0 + z)
    z = math.exp(max(value, -40.0))
    return z / (1.0 + z)


class BinaryLogit:
    """Small deterministic L2 logistic regression for the offline laptop path."""

    def __init__(self, l2: float = 2.0, iterations: int = 1_200):
        self.l2, self.iterations, self.weights = l2, iterations, []

    def fit(self, xs: Sequence[Sequence[float]], ys: Sequence[int]) -> "BinaryLogit":
        if not xs:
            raise ValueError("cannot fit empty outcome model")
        self.weights = [0.0] * len(xs[0])
        n = len(xs)
        for step in range(self.iterations):
            gradient = [0.0] * len(self.weights)
            for x, y in zip(xs, ys):
                error = _sigmoid(sum(w * v for w, v in zip(self.weights, x))) - y
                for j, value in enumerate(x):
                    gradient[j] += error * value
            rate = 0.35 / math.sqrt(1.0 + step / 80.0)
            for j in range(len(self.weights)):
                penalty = 0.0 if j == 0 else self.l2 * self.weights[j]
                self.weights[j] -= rate * (gradient[j] + penalty) / n
        return self

    def predict(self, x: Sequence[float]) -> float:
        return min(max(_sigmoid(sum(w * v for w, v in zip(self.weights, x))), 0.001), 0.999)


class Softmax:
    """Deterministic multinomial propensity model."""

    def __init__(self, labels: Sequence[str], l2: float = 2.0, iterations: int = 1_000):
        self.labels = list(labels)
        self.l2, self.iterations, self.weights = l2, iterations, []

    def fit(self, xs: Sequence[Sequence[float]], ys: Sequence[str]) -> "Softmax":
        self.weights = [[0.0] * len(xs[0]) for _ in self.labels]
        n = len(xs)
        for step in range(self.iterations):
            gradients = [[0.0] * len(xs[0]) for _ in self.labels]
            for x, y in zip(xs, ys):
                probabilities = self.predict(x)
                for k, label in enumerate(self.labels):
                    error = probabilities[label] - float(y == label)
                    for j, value in enumerate(x):
                        gradients[k][j] += error * value
            rate = 0.3 / math.sqrt(1.0 + step / 80.0)
            for k in range(len(self.labels)):
                for j in range(len(xs[0])):
                    penalty = 0.0 if j == 0 else self.l2 * self.weights[k][j]
                    self.weights[k][j] -= rate * (gradients[k][j] + penalty) / n
        return self

    def predict(self, x: Sequence[float]) -> Dict[str, float]:
        scores = [sum(w * v for w, v in zip(row, x)) for row in self.weights]
        top = max(scores)
        exp = [math.exp(value - top) for value in scores]
        total = sum(exp)
        return {label: value / total for label, value in zip(self.labels, exp)}

class FamilyModel:
    candidates: List[str]
    outcome_model: BinaryLogit
    propensity_model: Softmax
    counts: Dict[str, int]

    def vector(self, trajectory: Trajectory) -> List[float]:
        return [trajectory.feature_values[name] for name in self.feature_names]

    def augmented(self, base: Sequence[float], model: str) -> List[float]:
        values = list(base)
        for candidate in self.candidates[1:]:
            active = float(model == candidate)
            values.append(active)
            values.extend(active * value for value in base[1:])
        return values

    def risk(self, trajectory: Trajectory, model: str) -> float:
        return self.outcome_model.predict(self.augmented(self.vector(trajectory), model))

    def propensity(self, trajectory: Trajectory) -> Dict[str, float]:
        raw = self.propensity_model.predict(self.vector(trajectory))
        if not self.propensity_alpha:
            return raw
        # Dirichlet-style shrinkage toward the family model mix.  The local
        # pseudo-count is fixed before evaluation; alpha is an ablation parameter.
        local_strength = 20.0
        pooled = {
            candidate: (
                local_strength * raw[candidate]
                + self.propensity_alpha * self.priors[candidate]
            ) / (local_strength + self.propensity_alpha)
            for candidate in self.candidates
        }
        total = sum(pooled.values())
        return {candidate: value / total for candidate, value in pooled.items()}

            continue
        action = actions.get(trajectory.trajectory_id, trajectory.logged_model)
        if action not in model.candidates:
            action = trajectory.logged_model
        propensities = model.propensity(trajectory)
        action_propensity = propensities.get(action, 0.0)
        if action_propensity < MIN_PROPENSITY:
            action = trajectory.logged_model
        else:
            covered += int(action != trajectory.logged_model)
        mu_policy = model.risk(trajectory, action)
        mu_logged = model.risk(trajectory, trajectory.logged_model)
        if action == trajectory.logged_model:
            contributions.append(0.0)
        else:
            contributions.append(mu_policy - mu_logged)
            weights.append(1.0 / max(propensities[action], MIN_PROPENSITY))
    estimate = statistics.fmean(contributions) if contributions else 0.0
    rng = random.Random(SEED + seed_suffix)
    boots = []
    for _ in range(BOOTSTRAPS):
        sample = [contributions[rng.randrange(len(contributions))] for _ in contributions]
        boots.append(statistics.fmean(sample))
    boots.sort()
    upper = boots[min(int(0.95 * len(boots)), len(boots) - 1)] if boots else estimate
    return {
        "failure_delta": estimate,
        "failure_upper95": upper,
        "evaluation_n": len(contributions),
        "routed_coverage": covered / len(contributions) if contributions else 0.0,
        "effective_n": _effective_n(weights) if weights else len(contributions),
    }


def _proposal_priority(trajectory: Trajectory, route_data: Dict[str, Any], pricing: Dict[str, Sequence[float]]) -> Tuple[float, float]:
    initial = route_data["certified"][0]
    risks = route_data["risks"]
    risk_delta = risks[initial] - risks.get(trajectory.logged_model, risks[initial])
    logged, _ = route_cost(trajectory, [trajectory.logged_model] * len(trajectory.calls), pricing)
    routed, _ = route_cost(trajectory, route_data["certified"], pricing)
    return risk_delta, -(logged - routed)


def _adopt_actions(trajectories: Sequence[Trajectory], proposals: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]], pricing: Dict[str, Sequence[float]], fraction: float) -> Dict[str, str]:
    changed = [t for t in trajectories if proposals[t.trajectory_id]["certified"][0] != t.logged_model]
    changed.sort(key=lambda t: _proposal_priority(t, proposals[t.trajectory_id], pricing))
    take = int(round(fraction * len(changed)))
    adopted = {t.trajectory_id for t in changed[:take]}
    return {
        t.trajectory_id: proposals[t.trajectory_id]["certified"][0] if t.trajectory_id in adopted else t.logged_model
        for t in trajectories
    }


def _frontier(trajectories: Sequence[Trajectory], fitted: Dict[str, FamilyModel], official_fitted: Dict[str, FamilyModel], proposals: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]], pricing: Dict[str, Sequence[float]], output_ratios: Dict[str, float], selected_fraction: Optional[float] = None) -> Tuple[List[Dict[str, Any]], float]:
    rows = []
    for step in range(11):
        fraction = step / 10.0
        actions = _adopt_actions(trajectories, proposals, pricing, fraction)
        quality = estimate_policy(trajectories, fitted, actions, official=False, seed_suffix="-%s" % fraction)
        official = estimate_policy(trajectories, official_fitted, actions, official=True, seed_suffix="-official-%s" % fraction)
        logged_cost = routed_cost = adjusted_cost = 0.0
        for trajectory in trajectories:
            logged_route = [trajectory.logged_model] * len(trajectory.calls)
            route = [actions[trajectory.trajectory_id]] * len(trajectory.calls)
            logged_cost += route_cost(trajectory, logged_route, pricing)[0]
            routed_cost += route_cost(trajectory, route, pricing)[0]
            adjusted_cost += route_cost(trajectory, route, pricing, output_ratios=output_ratios)[0]
        rows.append({
            "adopt_frac": fraction,
            "cost_usd_est": round(routed_cost, 4),
            "behavior_adjusted_cost_usd_est": round(adjusted_cost, 4),
            "savings_pct": round((1.0 - routed_cost / logged_cost) * 100.0, 2) if logged_cost else 0.0,
            "proxy_quality": round(1.0 - quality["failure_delta"], 4),
            "failure_delta": round(quality["failure_delta"], 5),
            "failure_upper95": round(quality["failure_upper95"], 5),
            "official_failure_delta": round(official["failure_delta"], 5),
            "official_failure_upper95": round(official["failure_upper95"], 5),
            "coverage": round(quality["routed_coverage"], 4),
            "effective_n": round(quality["effective_n"], 1),
            "selected": False,
        })
    if selected_fraction is None:
        eligible = [row for row in rows if row["failure_upper95"] <= QUALITY_MARGIN]
        selected = min(eligible, key=lambda row: row["cost_usd_est"]) if eligible else rows[0]
        selected_fraction = selected["adopt_frac"]
    selected = min(rows, key=lambda row: abs(row["adopt_frac"] - selected_fraction))
    selected["selected"] = True
    return rows, selected["adopt_frac"]


def corrected_baseline(trajectory: Trajectory) -> List[str]:
    total = sum(call.input_tokens + call.tools_tokens for call in trajectory.calls)
    if total >= 15_000:
        return [trajectory.logged_model] * len(trajectory.calls)
    cheap = "claude-sonnet-5" if trajectory.family == "claude" else "gpt-5.6-luna"
    return [cheap] * len(trajectory.calls)

import json
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

SCRIPTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "scripts"
if str(SCRIPTS) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(SCRIPTS))

from cost_model import load_pricing
from routemaxxing import (
    Call,
    Outcome,
    Trajectory,
    choose_initial,
    infer_family,
    make_routes,
    outcome_from_items,
    route_cost,
    trajectory_from_row,
)


def message(role, text):
    kind = "output_text" if role == "assistant" else "input_text"
    return {"type": "message", "role": role, "content": [{"type": kind, "text": text}]}


def tool(name):
    return {"type": "function", "name": name, "parameters": {}}


def complete_row(model="claude-opus-5"):
    items = [
        message("system", "agent"), message("user", "fix the tests"),
        {"type": "function_call", "name": "bash", "arguments": '{"command":"test"}'},
        {"type": "function_call_output", "output": "ok"},
        message("assistant", "Done."),
    ]
    return {"model": model, "input": items, "tools": [tool("bash"), tool("file_edit")]}


class DummyModel:
    def __init__(self, risks, context_p90=10**9):
        self.candidates = list(risks)
        self.risks = risks
        self.context_p90 = context_p90

    def risk(self, trajectory, model):
        return self.risks[model]

    def propensity(self, trajectory):
        return {model: 1 / len(self.candidates) for model in self.candidates}


class RoutemaxxingTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_family_is_inferred_from_tool_dialect(self):
        self.assertEqual(infer_family([tool("bash"), tool("file_edit")]), "claude")
        self.assertEqual(infer_family([tool("shell_command"), tool("apply_patch")]), "gpt")

    def test_complete_history_decomposes_and_final_output_is_separately_observed(self):
        trajectory = trajectory_from_row(complete_row(), 0)
        self.assertEqual(trajectory.trajectory_id, __import__("hashlib").sha1(
            json.dumps(complete_row()["input"], sort_keys=True).encode()
        ).hexdigest()[:12])
        self.assertEqual(len(trajectory.calls), 2)
        self.assertFalse(trajectory.calls[0].is_final)
        self.assertTrue(trajectory.calls[1].is_final)
        self.assertGreater(trajectory.calls[1].output_tokens, 0)

    def test_failure_proxy_keeps_terminal_and_official_components_separate(self):
        items = complete_row()["input"][:-1] + [message("assistant", "Sorry, I was unable to finish.")]
        outcome = outcome_from_items(items)
        self.assertEqual(outcome.observed_failure, 1)
        self.assertEqual(outcome.official_failure, 0)

    def test_certified_initial_choice_never_upgrades_default(self):
        trajectory = trajectory_from_row(complete_row("claude-opus-5"), 0)
        model = DummyModel({
            "claude-sonnet-5": 0.30,
            "claude-opus-5": 0.20,
            "claude-fable-5": 0.10,
        })
        chosen, _, _ = choose_initial(trajectory, model, load_pricing(), margin=0.0)
        self.assertEqual(chosen, "claude-opus-5")

    def test_adaptive_route_switches_at_most_once_and_not_above_default(self):
        row = complete_row("claude-opus-5")
        row["input"] = row["input"][:-1] + [
            {"type": "function_call", "name": "bash", "arguments": '{"command":"test"}'},
            {"type": "function_call_output", "output": "ERROR: failed"},
            message("assistant", "Done."),
        ]
        trajectory = trajectory_from_row(row, 0)
        model = DummyModel({
            "claude-sonnet-5": 0.11,
            "claude-opus-5": 0.10,
            "claude-fable-5": 0.09,
        })
        result = make_routes(trajectory, model, load_pricing())
        route = result["adaptive"]
        switches = sum(route[i] != route[i - 1] for i in range(1, len(route)))
        self.assertLessEqual(switches, 1)
        self.assertNotIn("claude-fable-5", route)

    def test_model_switch_resets_cache_and_has_positive_penalty(self):
        trajectory = trajectory_from_row(complete_row("claude-opus-5"), 0)
        pricing = load_pricing()
        same_cost, same_penalty = route_cost(
            trajectory, ["claude-sonnet-5"] * len(trajectory.calls), pricing,
        )
        switched_cost, switch_penalty = route_cost(
            trajectory, ["claude-sonnet-5", "claude-opus-5"], pricing,
        )
        self.assertEqual(same_penalty, 0)
        self.assertGreater(switch_penalty, 0)
        self.assertGreater(switched_cost, same_cost)

import json
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

SCRIPTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "scripts"
if str(SCRIPTS) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(SCRIPTS))

from cost_model import load_pricing
from routemaxxing import (
    Call,
    Outcome,
    Trajectory,
    choose_initial,
    infer_family,
    make_routes,
    outcome_from_items,
    route_cost,
    trajectory_from_row,
)


def message(role, text):
    kind = "output_text" if role == "assistant" else "input_text"
    return {"type": "message", "role": role, "content": [{"type": kind, "text": text}]}


def tool(name):
    return {"type": "function", "name": name, "parameters": {}}


def complete_row(model="claude-opus-5"):
    items = [
        message("system", "agent"), message("user", "fix the tests"),
        {"type": "function_call", "name": "bash", "arguments": '{"command":"test"}'},
        {"type": "function_call_output", "output": "ok"},
        message("assistant", "Done."),
    ]
    return {"model": model, "input": items, "tools": [tool("bash"), tool("file_edit")]}


class DummyModel:
    def __init__(self, risks, context_p90=10**9):
        self.candidates = list(risks)
        self.risks = risks
        self.context_p90 = context_p90

    def risk(self, trajectory, model):
        return self.risks[model]

    def propensity(self, trajectory):
        return {model: 1 / len(self.candidates) for model in self.candidates}


class RoutemaxxingTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_family_is_inferred_from_tool_dialect(self):
        self.assertEqual(infer_family([tool("bash"), tool("file_edit")]), "claude")
        self.assertEqual(infer_family([tool("shell_command"), tool("apply_patch")]), "gpt")

    def test_complete_history_decomposes_and_final_output_is_separately_observed(self):
        trajectory = trajectory_from_row(complete_row(), 0)
        self.assertEqual(trajectory.trajectory_id, __import__("hashlib").sha1(
            json.dumps(complete_row()["input"], sort_keys=True).encode()
        ).hexdigest()[:12])
        self.assertEqual(len(trajectory.calls), 2)
        self.assertFalse(trajectory.calls[0].is_final)
        self.assertTrue(trajectory.calls[1].is_final)
        self.assertGreater(trajectory.calls[1].output_tokens, 0)

    def test_failure_proxy_keeps_terminal_and_official_components_separate(self):
        items = complete_row()["input"][:-1] + [message("assistant", "Sorry, I was unable to finish.")]
        outcome = outcome_from_items(items)
        self.assertEqual(outcome.observed_failure, 1)
        self.assertEqual(outcome.official_failure, 0)

    def test_certified_initial_choice_never_upgrades_default(self):
        trajectory = trajectory_from_row(complete_row("claude-opus-5"), 0)
        model = DummyModel({
            "claude-sonnet-5": 0.30,
            "claude-opus-5": 0.20,
            "claude-fable-5": 0.10,
        })
        chosen, _, _ = choose_initial(trajectory, model, load_pricing(), margin=0.0)
        self.assertEqual(chosen, "claude-opus-5")

    def test_adaptive_route_switches_at_most_once_and_not_above_default(self):
        row = complete_row("claude-opus-5")
        row["input"] = row["input"][:-1] + [
            {"type": "function_call", "name": "bash", "arguments": '{"command":"test"}'},
            {"type": "function_call_output", "output": "ERROR: failed"},
            message("assistant", "Done."),
        ]
        trajectory = trajectory_from_row(row, 0)
        model = DummyModel({
            "claude-sonnet-5": 0.11,
            "claude-opus-5": 0.10,
            "claude-fable-5": 0.09,
        })
        result = make_routes(trajectory, model, load_pricing())
        route = result["adaptive"]
        switches = sum(route[i] != route[i - 1] for i in range(1, len(route)))
        self.assertLessEqual(switches, 1)
        self.assertNotIn("claude-fable-5", route)

    def test_model_switch_resets_cache_and_has_positive_penalty(self):
        trajectory = trajectory_from_row(complete_row("claude-opus-5"), 0)
        pricing = load_pricing()
        same_cost, same_penalty = route_cost(
            trajectory, ["claude-sonnet-5"] * len(trajectory.calls), pricing,
        )
        switched_cost, switch_penalty = route_cost(
            trajectory, ["claude-sonnet-5", "claude-opus-5"], pricing,
        )
        self.assertEqual(same_penalty, 0)
        self.assertGreater(switch_penalty, 0)
        self.assertGreater(switched_cost, same_cost)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import json
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

SCRIPTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "scripts"
if str(SCRIPTS) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(SCRIPTS))

from cost_model import load_pricing
from routemaxxing import (
    Call,
    Outcome,
    Trajectory,
    choose_initial,
    infer_family,
    make_routes,
    outcome_from_items,
    route_cost,
    trajectory_from_row,
)


def message(role, text):
    kind = "output_text" if role == "assistant" else "input_text"
    return {"type": "message", "role": role, "content": [{"type": kind, "text": text}]}


def tool(name):
    return {"type": "function", "name": name, "parameters": {}}


def complete_row(model="claude-opus-5"):
    items = [
        message("system", "agent"), message("user", "fix the tests"),
        {"type": "function_call", "name": "bash", "arguments": '{"command":"test"}'},
        {"type": "function_call_output", "output": "ok"},
        message("assistant", "Done."),
    ]
    return {"model": model, "input": items, "tools": [tool("bash"), tool("file_edit")]}


class DummyModel:
    def __init__(self, risks, context_p90=10**9):
        self.candidates = list(risks)
        self.risks = risks
        self.context_p90 = context_p90

    def risk(self, trajectory, model):
        return self.risks[model]

    def propensity(self, trajectory):
        return {model: 1 / len(self.candidates) for model in self.candidates}


class RoutemaxxingTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_family_is_inferred_from_tool_dialect(self):
        self.assertEqual(infer_family([tool("bash"), tool("file_edit")]), "claude")
        self.assertEqual(infer_family([tool("shell_command"), tool("apply_patch")]), "gpt")

    def test_complete_history_decomposes_and_final_output_is_separately_observed(self):
        trajectory = trajectory_from_row(complete_row(), 0)
        self.assertEqual(trajectory.trajectory_id, __import__("hashlib").sha1(
            json.dumps(complete_row()["input"], sort_keys=True).encode()
        ).hexdigest()[:12])
        self.assertEqual(len(trajectory.calls), 2)
        self.assertFalse(trajectory.calls[0].is_final)
        self.assertTrue(trajectory.calls[1].is_final)
        self.assertGreater(trajectory.calls[1].output_tokens, 0)

    def test_failure_proxy_keeps_terminal_and_official_components_separate(self):
        items = complete_row()["input"][:-1] + [message("assistant", "Sorry, I was unable to finish.")]
        outcome = outcome_from_items(items)
        self.assertEqual(outcome.observed_failure, 1)
        self.assertEqual(outcome.official_failure, 0)

    def test_certified_initial_choice_never_upgrades_default(self):
        trajectory = trajectory_from_row(complete_row("claude-opus-5"), 0)
        model = DummyModel({
            "claude-sonnet-5": 0.30,
            "claude-opus-5": 0.20,
            "claude-fable-5": 0.10,
        })
        chosen, _, _ = choose_initial(trajectory, model, load_pricing(), margin=0.0)
        self.assertEqual(chosen, "claude-opus-5")

    def test_adaptive_route_switches_at_most_once_and_not_above_default(self):
        row = complete_row("claude-opus-5")
        row["input"] = row["input"][:-1] + [
            {"type": "function_call", "name": "bash", "arguments": '{"command":"test"}'},
            {"type": "function_call_output", "output": "ERROR: failed"},
            message("assistant", "Done."),
        ]
        trajectory = trajectory_from_row(row, 0)
        model = DummyModel({
            "claude-sonnet-5": 0.11,
            "claude-opus-5": 0.10,
            "claude-fable-5": 0.09,
        })
        result = make_routes(trajectory, model, load_pricing())
        route = result["adaptive"]
        switches = sum(route[i] != route[i - 1] for i in range(1, len(route)))
        self.assertLessEqual(switches, 1)
        self.assertNotIn("claude-fable-5", route)

    def test_model_switch_resets_cache_and_has_positive_penalty(self):
        trajectory = trajectory_from_row(complete_row("claude-opus-5"), 0)
        pricing = load_pricing()
        same_cost, same_penalty = route_cost(
            trajectory, ["claude-sonnet-5"] * len(trajectory.calls), pricing,
        )
        switched_cost, switch_penalty = route_cost(
            trajectory, ["claude-sonnet-5", "claude-opus-5"], pricing,
        )
        self.assertEqual(same_penalty, 0)
        self.assertGreater(switch_penalty, 0)
        self.assertGreater(switched_cost, same_cost)

def message(role, text):
    kind = "output_text" if role == "assistant" else "input_text"
    return {"type": "message", "role": role, "content": [{"type": kind, "text": text}]}


def tool(name):
    return {"type": "function", "name": name, "parameters": {}}


def complete_row(model="claude-opus-5"):
    items = [
        message("system", "agent"), message("user", "fix the tests"),
        {"type": "function_call", "name": "bash", "arguments": '{"command":"test"}'},
        {"type": "function_call_output", "output": "ok"},
        message("assistant", "Done."),
    ]
    return {"model": model, "input": items, "tools": [tool("bash"), tool("file_edit")]}


class DummyModel:
    def __init__(self, risks, context_p90=10**9):
        self.candidates = list(risks)
        self.risks = risks
        self.context_p90 = context_p90

    def risk(self, trajectory, model):
        return self.risks[model]

    def propensity(self, trajectory):
        return {model: 1 / len(self.candidates) for model in self.candidates}


class RoutemaxxingTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_family_is_inferred_from_tool_dialect(self):
        self.assertEqual(infer_family([tool("bash"), tool("file_edit")]), "claude")
        self.assertEqual(infer_family([tool("shell_command"), tool("apply_patch")]), "gpt")

    def test_complete_history_decomposes_and_final_output_is_separately_observed(self):
        trajectory = trajectory_from_row(complete_row(), 0)
        self.assertEqual(trajectory.trajectory_id, __import__("hashlib").sha1(
            json.dumps(complete_row()["input"], sort_keys=True).encode()
        ).hexdigest()[:12])
        self.assertEqual(len(trajectory.calls), 2)
        self.assertFalse(trajectory.calls[0].is_final)
        self.assertTrue(trajectory.calls[1].is_final)
        self.assertGreater(trajectory.calls[1].output_tokens, 0)

    def test_failure_proxy_keeps_terminal_and_official_components_separate(self):
        items = complete_row()["input"][:-1] + [message("assistant", "Sorry, I was unable to finish.")]
        outcome = outcome_from_items(items)
        self.assertEqual(outcome.observed_failure, 1)
        self.assertEqual(outcome.official_failure, 0)

    def test_certified_initial_choice_never_upgrades_default(self):
        trajectory = trajectory_from_row(complete_row("claude-opus-5"), 0)
        model = DummyModel({
            "claude-sonnet-5": 0.30,
            "claude-opus-5": 0.20,
            "claude-fable-5": 0.10,
        })
        chosen, _, _ = choose_initial(trajectory, model, load_pricing(), margin=0.0)
        self.assertEqual(chosen, "claude-opus-5")

    def test_adaptive_route_switches_at_most_once_and_not_above_default(self):
        row = complete_row("claude-opus-5")
        row["input"] = row["input"][:-1] + [
            {"type": "function_call", "name": "bash", "arguments": '{"command":"test"}'},
            {"type": "function_call_output", "output": "ERROR: failed"},
            message("assistant", "Done."),
        ]
        trajectory = trajectory_from_row(row, 0)
        model = DummyModel({
            "claude-sonnet-5": 0.11,
            "claude-opus-5": 0.10,
            "claude-fable-5": 0.09,
        })
        result = make_routes(trajectory, model, load_pricing())
        route = result["adaptive"]
        switches = sum(route[i] != route[i - 1] for i in range(1, len(route)))
        self.assertLessEqual(switches, 1)
        self.assertNotIn("claude-fable-5", route)

    def test_model_switch_resets_cache_and_has_positive_penalty(self):
        trajectory = trajectory_from_row(complete_row("claude-opus-5"), 0)
        pricing = load_pricing()
        same_cost, same_penalty = route_cost(
            trajectory, ["claude-sonnet-5"] * len(trajectory.calls), pricing,

        switched_cost, switch_penalty = route_cost(
            trajectory, ["claude-sonnet-5", "claude-opus-5"], pricing,
        )
        self.assertEqual(same_penalty, 0)
        self.assertGreater(switch_penalty, 0)
        self.assertGreater(switched_cost, same_cost)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Cache-aware cost model on ESTIMATED tokens.

The export has no `usage` field: every token count here is estimated as
serialized chars / 4 (see load_trajectories.est_tokens). The cache trap still
applies: providers cache the shared input prefix across consecutive calls of a
task, and a model switch resets that cache — the first call after a switch
pays the uncached rate for the whole prefix.

Cached share of call i is estimated as the token size of the item-level prefix
that call i shares with call i-1 of the same trajectory.

Model ids are real models with real prices. DEFAULT_PRICING below is the
official per-model schedule (per 1M tokens). Note fable-5 is the premium tier
(most expensive), and gpt-5.6-luna the cheapest. Cached input uses the
cache-READ rate; the cache-write premium and long-context/fast tiers are not
modeled (input-side estimates only). Unknown ids fall back to their family
rate by longest prefix; scripts/pricing.json overrides everything.
"""
import json
from pathlib import Path
from load_trajectories import est_tokens

DEFAULT_PRICING = {  # per 1M tokens: [uncached_input, cached_input(read), output] — official rates
    "claude-opus-5": [5.00, 0.50, 25.00],
    "claude-opus-4-8": [5.00, 0.50, 25.00],
    "claude-opus-4-6": [5.00, 0.50, 25.00],
    "claude-sonnet-5": [2.00, 0.20, 10.00],
    "claude-sonnet-4-6": [3.00, 0.30, 15.00],
    "claude-fable-5": [10.00, 1.00, 50.00],  # premium tier — most expensive model in the log
    "gpt-5.6-sol": [5.00, 0.50, 30.00],
    "gpt-5.6-terra": [2.00, 0.20, 12.00],
    "gpt-5.6-luna": [0.20, 0.02, 1.20],      # cheapest model in the log
    "claude-opus": [5.00, 0.50, 25.00],      # family fallbacks for unseen generations
    "claude-sonnet": [2.00, 0.20, 10.00],
    "claude-fable": [10.00, 1.00, 50.00],
    "gpt-5.6": [2.00, 0.20, 12.00],
    "_default": [2.00, 0.20, 10.00],
}

def load_pricing():
    p = Path(__file__).parent / "pricing.json"
    return json.loads(p.read_text()) if p.exists() else DEFAULT_PRICING

def price_of(model, pricing):
    if model in pricing: return pricing[model]
    for prefix in sorted(pricing, key=len, reverse=True):  # longest family prefix wins
        if prefix != "_default" and model.startswith(prefix): return pricing[prefix]
    return pricing["_default"]

def shared_prefix_tokens(prev_req, req):
    """Estimated tokens of the item-level input prefix shared with the previous call."""
    shared = 0
    for a, b in zip(prev_req["input"], req["input"]):
        if a == b: shared += est_tokens(a)
        else: break
    return shared

def trajectory_cost(calls, route, pricing=None):
    """Cost of a reconstructed trajectory (calls ordered by input length) if call i
    had been served by route[i]. Cache-aware: the shared prefix is billed at the
    cached rate only when route[i] == route[i-1]. Output tokens are unknowable
    (no outputs in the export) and are NOT included — say so when you quote numbers.
    Returns (usd, uncached_input_tokens_est)."""
    pricing = pricing or load_pricing()
    usd, uncached_total = 0.0, 0
    for i, c in enumerate(calls):
        inp = est_tokens(c["input"])
        cached = shared_prefix_tokens(calls[i - 1], c) if (i > 0 and route[i] == route[i - 1]) else 0
        cached = min(cached, inp)
        uncached = inp - cached
        pu, pc, _ = price_of(route[i], pricing)
        usd += (uncached * pu + cached * pc) / 1e6
        uncached_total += uncached
    return usd, uncached_total

def logged_route(calls): return [c["model"] for c in calls]

# Routemaxxing Routemaxxing minimizes estimated, cache-aware model cost subject to a two-percentage- point upper bound on automatic failure-proxy degradation. It runs fully offline and uses only information available before each routing decision. ## The structural finding The public chunk contains 1,000 unique histories. Their item sequences unfold into 10,845 model turns: model-authored runs produce tool calls or prose, and environment items close one call and begin the next. The briefing-compatible analysis treats the last output of every trajectory as unobservable. The two model families also have disjoint tool dialects. Claude histories expose `bash`/`file_edit`; GPT histories expose `shell_command`/`apply_patch`. Routemaxxing therefore routes only within a family rather than inventing an unsupported cross-family counterfactual. ## Policy The certified policy reads the opening task, trigger, toolset, initial size, images, and nameable intent flags. It chooses the cheapest propensity-supported model whose fitted failure risk is within two points of the best supported model, but never upgrades above the configured default. It then keeps that model for the whole trajectory to preserve the provider cache. The adaptive policy starts from the certified choice and may escalate once after an observed tool error, repeated action, or high-risk context growth. It never downgrades or exceeds the original default. Its result is explicitly conditional on logged states: a different early model could have generated a different later context. ## Evaluation - Deterministic 70/30 split grouped by recoverable thread identity, falling back to the stable trajectory hash. - L2 logistic outcome models and multinomial propensity models trained on the public training split. - Downgrade-from-default effects estimated with propensity-screened outcome regression; unsupported actions fall back to the configured model. - Two thousand trajectory bootstrap replicates provide the one-sided 95% upper bound. - Cost includes estimated uncached input, cached prefix reads, and every observable output. A switch resets the accumulated cache. Tokens are serialized JSON chars/4, never measured usage. - The sensitivity columns remove terminal assistant language from the quality proxy and adjust output length using training-split model ratios. The automatic failure proxy combines terminal inability language, an unresolved final tool error, and repeated identical-action loops. It is not ground-truth task quality. The organizer-held-out split is not present yet, so public-validation numbers must not be presented as final held-out results. ## Reproduce ```bash python scripts/routemaxxing.py export/ python -m pytest -q python -m explorer ``` Generated evidence is under `results/routemaxxing/`; the explorer-compatible route is `results/routemaxxing.jsonl`; and the six-slide deck is `presentation-routemaxxing.html`. The summary JSON is the source of every headline number in the deck. # Viktor Challenge Starter — Build the Router Starter kit for the **Viktor Challenge** at the TUM.ai hackathon (Munich, 22–23 Aug 2026). From real LLM-request logs, build a router that picks the right model for every call — then prove it works, even though the log shows only the model that ran, and no outputs or token counts. ## Quick start (5 minutes) ```bash # 1. No dataset yet? Generate a synthetic sample with the same shape: python scripts/make_synthetic_sample.py # writes ./export/ # 2. Got the real dataset links (shipped at kickoff)? Then instead: the export ships # as trajectories_v1_.jsonl.tar.gz archives — download, verify the posted # SHA-256, then: mkdir -p export && tar xzf trajectories_v1_01.jsonl.tar.gz -C export/ # 3. Sanity-check the export, reconstruct trajectories, print stats: python scripts/load_trajectories.py export/ # 4. Run the baseline heuristic router + cache-aware cost report: python scripts/baseline_router.py export/ # 5. Turn results into a cost–quality frontier CSV (+ PNG if matplotlib is installed): python scripts/plot_frontier.py results/routes.jsonl ``` Python 3.10+, standard library only (matplotlib optional for the PNG). ## Routemaxxing The challenge implementation corrects the unit of analysis before routing: the real chunk's 1,000 unique rows unfold into 10,845 model turns. It trains an interpretable, family-preserving downgrade policy and reports a public-validation frontier with a 2-percentage-point proxy-quality constraint: ```bash python scripts/routemaxxing.py export/ ``` The command writes the certified and one-escalation route ledgers, frontier CSV/SVG, and a fully traceable summary under `results/routemaxxing/`. It also writes `results/routemaxxing.jsonl` for the local explorer and refreshes `presentation-routemaxxing.html`. All token and dollar figures are estimates; final outputs are excluded in the briefing-compatible primary analysis, and adaptive quality is explicitly conditional on the logged context. ## Using a coding agent Point Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / opencode at this repo — `AGENTS.md` briefs your agent. In Claude Code you also get slash commands: - `/setup` — set up everything needed to participate - `/make-presentation` — build a Viktor-branded presentation of your solution - `/prepare-submission` — package your solution into a formal submission ## What's here | Path | What | |---|---| | `AGENTS.md` | Agent briefing: dataset shape, the cache trap, judging, starter ideas | | `skills/` | The three guided workflows above (plain Markdown, readable by humans too) | | `scripts/` | Loader + trajectory reconstruction, baseline router, cache-aware cost model (estimated tokens), frontier plot, synthetic sample | | `templates/presentation.html` | Self-contained branded slide template | ## Rules that matter - **License:** challenge use only — no redistribution of the dataset. Full terms ship with the download. - No GPU or API keys needed. Judge-model rescoring is allowed (credits announced at kickoff). - Questions → the challenge Discord; the Viktor team answers there all weekend. """FastAPI server for the local trajectory explorer."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Sequence

import duckdb
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Query
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles

from . import analysis
from .index import DB_PATH, ROOT, ensure_index


STATIC_DIR = Path(__file__).with_name("static")
DEFAULT_COLUMNS = [
    "call_id", "trajectory_id", "call_index", "n_calls_in_trajectory",
    "model", "model_family", "tier_rank", "est_input_tokens",
    "est_new_tokens", "shared_prefix_tokens", "prefix_share", "n_items",
    "last_item_type", "last_tool_name", "n_distinct_tools", "has_image",
    "has_reasoning", "tool_output_error", "repeat_tool", "output_kind",
    "output_n_tool_calls", "output_tool_names", "output_prose_tokens",
    "routine", "chosen_model", "kept_logged", "direction", "p_routine",
    "flip_lambda", "cost_usd", "switch_penalty_usd", "split",
]


def _connect(db_path: Path):
    return duckdb.connect(str(db_path), read_only=True)


def _column_info(con: Any, table: str = "calls") -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    return [
        {"name": row[1], "type": row[2], "nullable": not row[3]}
        for row in con.execute("PRAGMA table_info('%s')" % table).fetchall()
    ]


def _quote_identifier(value: str) -> str:
    return '"%s"' % value.replace('"', '""')


def _json_rows(cursor: Any) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    names = [description[0] for description in cursor.description]
    return [dict(zip(names, row)) for row in cursor.fetchall()]


def create_app(db_path: Path = DB_PATH, static_dir: Path = STATIC_DIR) -> FastAPI:
    db_path, static_dir = Path(db_path), Path(static_dir)
    app = FastAPI(
        title="Viktor Trajectory Explorer",
        docs_url="/api/docs",
        redoc_url=None,
    )
    app.state.db_path = db_path

    @app.get("/api/schema")
    def schema() -> Dict[str, Any]:
        with _connect(app.state.db_path) as con:
            columns = _column_info(con)
            sources = _json_rows(con.execute(
                """SELECT kind, path, line_count, parse_errors, size_bytes,
                          mtime_ns
                   FROM sources ORDER BY kind, path"""
            ))
            counts = con.execute(
                "SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM calls), "
                "(SELECT count(*) FROM trajectories)"
            ).fetchone()
            estimator = con.execute(
                "SELECT value FROM index_meta WHERE key = 'token_estimator'"
            ).fetchone()
        return {
            "columns": columns,
            "default_columns": DEFAULT_COLUMNS,
            "sources": sources,
            "source_kinds": sorted({source["kind"] for source in sources}),
            "calls": counts[0],
            "trajectories": counts[1],
            "token_estimator": estimator[0] if estimator else None,
        }

    @app.get("/api/calls")
    def calls(
        offset: int = Query(0, ge=0),
        limit: int = Query(200, ge=1, le=500),
        sort: str = Query("call_id"),
        order: str = Query("asc", pattern="^(asc|desc)$"),
        columns: Optional[str] = Query(None),
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        started = time.perf_counter()
        with _connect(app.state.db_path) as con:
            available = {column["name"] for column in _column_info(con)}
            if sort not in available:
                raise HTTPException(400, "unknown sort column: %s" % sort)
            selected = [part.strip() for part in columns.split(",")] if columns else list(DEFAULT_COLUMNS)
            selected = [column for column in selected if column]
            unknown = sorted(set(selected) - available)
            if unknown:
                raise HTTPException(400, "unknown columns: %s" % ", ".join(unknown))
            if "call_id" not in selected:
                selected.insert(0, "call_id")
            selected = list(dict.fromkeys(selected))
            select_sql = ", ".join(_quote_identifier(column) for column in selected)
            sort_sql = _quote_identifier(sort)
            cursor = con.execute(
                "SELECT %s FROM calls ORDER BY %s %s NULLS LAST, call_id ASC "
                "LIMIT ? OFFSET ?" % (select_sql, sort_sql, order.upper()),
                [limit, offset],
            )
            rows = _json_rows(cursor)
            total = con.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM calls").fetchone()[0]
        return {
            "rows": rows,
            "total": total,
            "offset": offset,
            "limit": limit,
            "sort": sort,
            "order": order,
            "elapsed_ms": round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, 2),
        }

    @app.get("/api/overview")
    def overview() -> Dict[str, Any]:
        with _connect(app.state.db_path) as con:
            return analysis.overview(con)

        with _connect(app.state.db_path) as con:
            return analysis.classes(con, axis)

import json
import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

import duckdb

from explorer.index import ensure_index
from scripts.load_trajectories import group_key
from scripts.trajectory_ids import sha


def message(role, text):
    return {
        "type": "message",
        "role": role,
        "content": [{"type": "input_text", "text": text}],
    }


def request(model, items):
    return {
        "model": model,
        "input": items,
        "tools": [{
            "type": "function", "name": "shell",
            "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {}},
        }],
    }


class ExplorerIndexTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.db = self.root / "explorer" / "index.duckdb"

    def tearDown(self):
        self.temp.cleanup()

    def write_jsonl(self, relative, rows):
        path = self.root / relative
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        encoded = [json.dumps(row, separators=(",", ":")) for row in rows]
        path.write_text("\n".join(encoded) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        return path, encoded

    def fixture_exports(self):
        base = [message("system", "snapshot system"), message("user", "snapshot task")]
        first = request("gpt-5.6-terra", base)
        second = request("gpt-5.6-terra", base + [
            {"type": "function_call", "name": "shell", "arguments": "{\"cmd\":\"ok\"}"},
            {"type": "function_call_output", "output": "ok"},
        ])
        history_items = [
            message("system", "history system"), message("user", "history task"),
            {"type": "reasoning", "summary": []},
            {"type": "function_call", "name": "shell", "arguments": "{\"cmd\":\"bad\"}"},
            {"type": "function_call_output", "output": "ERROR: failed"},
            message("assistant", "Recovered."),
        ]
        history = request("claude-sonnet-5", history_items)
        return first, second, history

    def test_ids_derived_columns_final_nulls_and_raw_provenance(self):
        first, second, history = self.fixture_exports()
        _, encoded = self.write_jsonl("export/sample.jsonl", [first, second, history])
        result = ensure_index(self.root, self.db, progress=None)
        self.assertEqual((result.calls, result.trajectories), (4, 2))

        con = duckdb.connect(str(self.db), read_only=True)
        ids = {row[0] for row in con.execute("SELECT trajectory_id FROM trajectories").fetchall()}
        # No trace.py exists in this checkout. These are its two authoritative
        # predecessors: load_trajectories for snapshots and trajectory_ids /
        # decompose for complete-history rows.
        self.assertEqual(ids, {group_key(first), sha(history["input"], 12)})

        final_bad = con.execute("""SELECT count(*) FROM calls WHERE is_final AND (
            output_kind <> 'unobservable' OR output_n_tool_calls IS NOT NULL OR
            output_tool_names IS NOT NULL OR output_prose_tokens IS NOT NULL OR
            routine IS NOT NULL)""").fetchone()[0]
        self.assertEqual(final_bad, 0)
        first_call = con.execute("""SELECT output_kind, output_n_tool_calls,
            output_tool_names, item_type_sequence, last_item_type
            FROM calls WHERE trajectory_id = ? AND call_index = 0""", [group_key(first)]).fetchone()
        self.assertEqual(first_call, ("tool_call", 1, ["shell"], "sys,user", "user"))
        self.assertEqual(
            con.execute("SELECT raw_json FROM raw_lines WHERE source_line = 1").fetchone()[0],
            encoded[0],
        )
        con.close()

    def test_ledger_join_and_switch_penalty(self):
        first, second, _ = self.fixture_exports()
        self.write_jsonl("export/sample.jsonl", [first, second])
        trajectory_id = group_key(first)
        self.write_jsonl("results/router.jsonl", [{
            "trajectory_id": trajectory_id,
            "n_calls": 2,
            "logged_model": "gpt-5.6-terra",
            "route": ["gpt-5.6-luna", "gpt-5.6-sol"],
            "p_routine": 0.8,
            "flip_lambda": 0.2,
            "split": "test",
            "routine": True,
        }])
        ensure_index(self.root, self.db, progress=None)
        con = duckdb.connect(str(self.db), read_only=True)
        rows = con.execute("""SELECT chosen_model, kept_logged, direction,
            p_routine, flip_lambda, split, routine, switch_penalty_usd
            FROM calls ORDER BY call_index""").fetchall()
        self.assertEqual(rows[0][:7], (
            "gpt-5.6-luna", False, "downgraded", 0.8, 0.2, "test", True,
        ))
        self.assertEqual(rows[1][0:3], ("gpt-5.6-sol", False, "upgraded"))
        self.assertIsNone(rows[1][6])
        self.assertGreater(rows[1][7], 0)
        con.close()

    def test_export_only_and_incremental_manifest(self):
        first, second, _ = self.fixture_exports()
        source, _ = self.write_jsonl("export/sample.jsonl", [first, second])
        built = ensure_index(self.root, self.db, progress=None)
        current = ensure_index(self.root, self.db, progress=None)
        self.assertTrue(built.rebuilt)
        self.assertFalse(current.rebuilt)
        stat = source.stat()
        os.utime(source, ns=(stat.st_atime_ns, stat.st_mtime_ns + 1_000_000))
        changed = ensure_index(self.root, self.db, progress=None)

import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

import duckdb

from explorer.index import ensure_index
from scripts.load_trajectories import group_key
from scripts.trajectory_ids import sha


def message(role, text):
    return {
        "type": "message",
        "role": role,
        "content": [{"type": "input_text", "text": text}],
    }


def request(model, items):
    return {
        "model": model,
        "input": items,
        "tools": [{
            "type": "function", "name": "shell",
            "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {}},
        }],
    }


class ExplorerIndexTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.db = self.root / "explorer" / "index.duckdb"

    def tearDown(self):
        self.temp.cleanup()

    def write_jsonl(self, relative, rows):
        path = self.root / relative
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        encoded = [json.dumps(row, separators=(",", ":")) for row in rows]
        path.write_text("\n".join(encoded) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        return path, encoded

    def fixture_exports(self):
        base = [message("system", "snapshot system"), message("user", "snapshot task")]
        first = request("gpt-5.6-terra", base)
        second = request("gpt-5.6-terra", base + [
            {"type": "function_call", "name": "shell", "arguments": "{\"cmd\":\"ok\"}"},
            {"type": "function_call_output", "output": "ok"},
        ])
        history_items = [
            message("system", "history system"), message("user", "history task"),
            {"type": "reasoning", "summary": []},
            {"type": "function_call", "name": "shell", "arguments": "{\"cmd\":\"bad\"}"},
            {"type": "function_call_output", "output": "ERROR: failed"},
            message("assistant", "Recovered."),
        ]
        history = request("claude-sonnet-5", history_items)
        return first, second, history

    def test_ids_derived_columns_final_nulls_and_raw_provenance(self):
        first, second, history = self.fixture_exports()
        _, encoded = self.write_jsonl("export/sample.jsonl", [first, second, history])
        result = ensure_index(self.root, self.db, progress=None)
        self.assertEqual((result.calls, result.trajectories), (4, 2))

        con = duckdb.connect(str(self.db), read_only=True)
        ids = {row[0] for row in con.execute("SELECT trajectory_id FROM trajectories").fetchall()}
        # No trace.py exists in this checkout. These are its two authoritative
        # predecessors: load_trajectories for snapshots and trajectory_ids /
        # decompose for complete-history rows.
        self.assertEqual(ids, {group_key(first), sha(history["input"], 12)})

        final_bad = con.execute("""SELECT count(*) FROM calls WHERE is_final AND (
            output_kind <> 'unobservable' OR output_n_tool_calls IS NOT NULL OR
            output_tool_names IS NOT NULL OR output_prose_tokens IS NOT NULL OR
            routine IS NOT NULL)""").fetchone()[0]
        self.assertEqual(final_bad, 0)
        first_call = con.execute("""SELECT output_kind, output_n_tool_calls,
            output_tool_names, item_type_sequence, last_item_type
            FROM calls WHERE trajectory_id = ? AND call_index = 0""", [group_key(first)]).fetchone()
        self.assertEqual(first_call, ("tool_call", 1, ["shell"], "sys,user", "user"))
        self.assertEqual(
            con.execute("SELECT raw_json FROM raw_lines WHERE source_line = 1").fetchone()[0],
            encoded[0],
        )
        con.close()

    def test_ledger_join_and_switch_penalty(self):
        first, second, _ = self.fixture_exports()
        self.write_jsonl("export/sample.jsonl", [first, second])
        trajectory_id = group_key(first)
        self.write_jsonl("results/router.jsonl", [{
            "trajectory_id": trajectory_id,
            "n_calls": 2,
            "logged_model": "gpt-5.6-terra",
            "route": ["gpt-5.6-luna", "gpt-5.6-sol"],
            "p_routine": 0.8,
            "flip_lambda": 0.2,
            "split": "test",
            "routine": True,
        }])
        ensure_index(self.root, self.db, progress=None)
        con = duckdb.connect(str(self.db), read_only=True)
        rows = con.execute("""SELECT chosen_model, kept_logged, direction,
            p_routine, flip_lambda, split, routine, switch_penalty_usd
            FROM calls ORDER BY call_index""").fetchall()
        self.assertEqual(rows[0][:7], (

        self.assertIsNone(rows[1][6])
        self.assertGreater(rows[1][7], 0)
        con.close()

const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:".venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import csv, json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('results/routemaxxing')
rows=list(csv.DictReader((root/'training_sweep.csv').open()))
out=[]
policies=sorted({r['policy'] for r in rows})
caps=['0.0','0.01','0.02','none']
for policy in policies:
 for cap in caps:
  candidates=[r for r in rows if r['policy']==policy and r['risk_cap']==cap]
  for margin in (0.0,.005,.01,.02):
   eligible=[r for r in candidates if float(r['failure_upper95'])<=margin and float(r['savings_pct'])>=0 and float(r['behavior_adjusted_savings_pct'])>=0 and (int(r['routed_n'])==0 or float(r['effective_n'])>=15)]
   selected=min(eligible,key=lambda r:float(r['behavior_adjusted_cost_usd_est'])) if eligible else candidates[0]
   out.append({'policy':policy,'individual_risk_cap':cap,'global_upper95_margin':margin,**{k:v for k,v in selected.items() if k not in ('policy','risk_cap')}})
with (root/'quality_margin_sweep.csv').open('w',newline='') as f:
 w=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=list(out[0])); w.writeheader(); w.writerows(out)
summary=json.loads((root/'summary.json').read_text())
summary['artifacts']['quality_margin_sweep']='quality_margin_sweep.csv'
(root/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')

8:
The signal

Global risk budget, local positive savings

Nameable structure

Tool dialect locks the family. At call zero we use trigger, intent, prompt size, image and toolset—never eventual depth, realized tools, future errors or the ending.

The change

Rank supported downgrades by training-predicted cache-aware dollars / proxy risk. Admit only actions predicted to save under fixed and output-length-adjusted costing. Keep one model for the trajectory.

10:
Honesty

What the log can—and cannot—identify

  • Method — Family-restricted propensity screen + outcome regression; 2,000 trajectory bootstraps. Primary proxy excludes the unobservable final answer.
  • Support — Routed ESS 155.4; minimum target propensity 0.255. Luna has 12 training rows versus 20 required, so it is never selected.
  • Known weakness — Proxy risk is not measured task quality, and a different early model may create a different later state. Adaptive results are conditional, not causal.

content.text:
Implemented and committed on `routemaxing`.

| Public validation | Fixed-shape cost | Behavior-adjusted | Savings | Failure upper95 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Logged behavior | $88.88 | $88.88 | — | — |
| Corrected heuristic | $74.68 | $74.64 | 15.97% | −0.01 pp |
| Current certified | $68.98 | $68.84* | 22.39% | −0.19 pp |
| Improved certified | **$48.18** | **$47.90** | **45.79%** | **−0.19 pp** |
| Adaptive, conditional | $79.53 | $79.44 | 10.52% | Not causally estimated |

\*Current router repriced with the new output-length sensitivity for a fair comparison.

The improved router saves another $20.80 fixed-shape and $20.95 behavior-adjusted. Coverage rises from 41.7% to 58.3%, with ESS 155.4 and minimum target propensity 0.255.

Key changes:

- Training-only dollars-per-proxy-risk proposal ranking.
- No future depth, outputs, tool calls, or errors in certified decisions.
- Same-family, whole-trajectory downgrades only.
- Unsupported defaults remain unchanged.
- Luna excluded: 12 training examples versus 20 required.
- Adaptive escalation uses an explicit cache break-even check and remains separately reported.
- Primary proxy excludes the unobservable final answer. The terminal-language sensitivity upper95 is −0.76 pp.
- Enriched features and partial pooling were retained as ablations; they found the same routes, so the simpler policy won.

Verification: 55 tests and 21 subtests pass. All 1,000 routes and 10,845 calls join the explorer. `initial_context/` remains untouched.

- [Router implementation](/Users/utkukalkanli/Developer/viktor/ai-slop-router/scripts/routemaxxing.py)
- [Evaluation summary](/Users/utkukalkanli/Developer/viktor/ai-slop-router/results/routemaxxing/summary.json)

- [Methodology](/Users/utkukalkanli/Developer/viktor/ai-slop-router/ROUTEMAXXING.md)
